response.sql:
SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS raceName, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS averageLaps
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12
  AND res.laps IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
ORDER BY averageLaps DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Treats the cutoff of 12 as inclusive (positionOrder >= 12). `AVG` ignores NULL laps; races with no nonmissing lap values are omitted because the filter removes them before grouping.

alternatives.interpretation: If races with no recorded lap values should remain in the output with a NULL average, retain all qualifying results and let AVG ignore missing values; NULL averages then sort last.
